Description.SourceString:
The results of the qualitative interrogation are on your desk, Sir.

As you know, we asked ten human prisoners about the latest round of penguin disguises. We asked them to score each disguise out of 10 in three categories: Unexpectedness, Likelihood of Discovery, and Ability to Confound. This gave each disguise a number out of 30. The higher the score, the more dastardly the disguise.

The executive summary, Sir, is that one disguise scored significantly higher than the others. It is the penguin suit, sir. There is no disguise more unexpected, more confounding, than a penguin disguised as a penguin. Humans simply cannot fathom it.

I send you the helmet of the disguise, Sir, so that you can marvel at the audacity.
